title: Rule-RuleSet-Version
description: JSON schema for creating or updating a Pega ruleset version record (Rule-RuleSet-Version). This is an infrastructure rule type with no class association. pyRuleSetVersion is always empty — the version identifier is pyRuleSetVersionID.

pyRuleSet.description: Self-referential — always equals pyRuleSetName. The server forces this on save.

pyRuleSetName.description: The ruleset name — must match pyRuleSet. Required by the server to validate the parent Rule-RuleSet-Name exists. Without this field, version creation fails with 'Unknown RuleSet'.

pyRuleSetVersionID.description: Version number in MAJOR-MINOR-PATCH format with two-digit zero-padded segments (e.g., '01-01-01'). Cannot be '00-00-00'.

pyDescription.description: Human-readable description of what is in this version.

pyRuleSetVersionEffectiveDate.description: Date the version became (or becomes) effective — format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Auto-generated from pxCreateDateTime when blank.

pyVersionSecure.description: 'true' to password-protect rule checkout in this version.

pyVersionPassword.description: Bcrypt-hashed password (set when pyVersionSecure is 'true'). Leave empty for unsecured versions. Cannot be set as plaintext via the API.

pyRequiresApproval.description: 'true' to require approval for rule check-in in this version.

pyDisplayMode.description: Display mode for Dev Studio UI — typically 'advanced' or ''.

pyRulePrefix.description: Custom prefix applied to rule names created in this version (usually '').

pyUsage.description: Brief usage note — same convention as pyLabel ('{RuleSetName}:{Version}').

pyBranchRuleSet.description: 'true' if this version record belongs to a branch ruleset.

pyBranchID.description: Branch only. The branch identifier — must match the pyBranchID on the parent Rule-RuleSet-Name.

pyBranchOrigin.description: Branch only. The base ruleset this branch was created from — must match the pyBranchOrigin on the parent Rule-RuleSet-Name.

pyRequiresRuleSetVersion.description: Dependency declarations — each entry is '{RuleSetName}:{Version}' (e.g., 'Pega-ProcessCommander:08-01-01'). At least one prerequisite is required unless the ruleset is Pega-RULES.

pyRequiresRuleSetVersionPageList.description: Page-list mirror of pyRequiresRuleSetVersion (same data, different format). Populate pyRequiresRuleSetVersion only — the server mirrors the data into this field on save.

pyComponentEntryPoints.description: Entry points this ruleset exposes (Component framework). Empty for standard application rulesets.

pyDeclarativeComponentCallbacks.description: Declarative callbacks (Component framework). Empty for standard application rulesets.

pyRuleSetVersion.description: Always empty for Rule-RuleSet-Version (the version identifier is pyRuleSetVersionID, not this field).

pyComponentEntryPointName.description: Rule name of the entry point.

pyDeclarativeComponentProperty.description: Property name on the interface class.
